title: PDF Text & Table Extractor
description: PDF URLs in; per-page, per-document or RAG-chunk items out with text, markdown, ruled tables and optional OCR. Charged per page delivered.

urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Direct links to PDF files (http or https), one per line. Must be the PDF itself, not a viewer page such as Google Docs or a browser preview. Each URL is fetched once with a plain GET, no proxy, no login; requests to the same host are spaced at least one second apart. You are responsible for the hosting site's terms and robots rules.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: page = one item per page (CSV and Google Sheets friendly). document = one item per PDF with full text, markdown and a pages array. chunk = RAG chunks of chunkSize characters with page and character offsets. A free document summary row is always written.

includeMarkdown.title: Markdown
includeMarkdown.description: Add a markdown field: headings inferred from font-size rank, paragraphs from line gaps, tables as GitHub tables when extractTables is on. Heuristic, not a layout model.

extractTables.title: Extract ruled tables
extractTables.description: Detect tables drawn with ruling lines and return them as arrays of rows. Borderless tables stay in the text. Adds about 0.3-0.5 s per page. No extra charge.

pageRange.title: Page range
pageRange.description: Pages to extract, 1-based, e.g. 1-5, 8, 12- (12 to end). Empty = all pages. Pages outside the range are never charged.

maxPagesPerPdf.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPagesPerPdf.description: Pages beyond this are not extracted or charged; the document row gets status partial with errorCode pages_capped. Raise it deliberately for long documents.

maxPages.title: Max pages (total, charged)
maxPages.description: Hard stop for the whole run. Your main cost control: at $0.0003 per page, 5000 pages = $1.50. Documents not reached are reported with errorCode budget_exhausted and are free. 0 = no limit.

maxPdfMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxPdfMb.description: Files larger than this are refused before download (Content-Length) and aborted during download. Free error row too_large. The effective cap is also bounded by the run's memory (memory MB / 4).

ocr.title: OCR scanned pages
ocr.description: Run Tesseract (English) on pages that have no text layer but contain an image. Such pages are charged as OCR page ($0.003) instead of page. Off = those pages are delivered empty with needsOcr true, free.
ocr.sectionDescription: Only pages with fewer than 20 text characters and at least one image object are OCRed, at 200 dpi grayscale. Measured accuracy 93-97% on clean scans of printed English.

ocrLanguage.title: OCR language
ocrLanguage.description: Tesseract language pack. Only packs shipped in the image are listed.

maxOcrPagesPerPdf.title: Max OCR pages per PDF
maxOcrPagesPerPdf.description: OCR cost control. Remaining image-only pages are delivered empty with needsOcr true and are not charged.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: Used only in chunk mode. 1500 characters is roughly 375 tokens. Split at paragraph, then sentence, then hard cut.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Tail of the previous chunk repeated at the start of the next. Clamped to half of chunkSize.

pdfPassword.title: PDF password (optional)
pdfPassword.description: Applied to every password-protected PDF in this run. Wrong or missing password = free error row password_required. PDFs whose owner disabled text copying are always skipped (free error row permissions_restricted); there is no override.
